page_title: CRO 1-1 BRA (PEN: 4-2) | Croatia v Brazil 09/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 121' The nerve-wracking penalty shoot-out has just ended, with a clear winner finally emerging.
121' Marquinhos (Brazil) fails to convert the penalty kick! His effort hits the left post.
121' Goal! Mislav Orsic (Croatia) calmly steps up and places the ball into the bottom left corner.
121' Goal! Pedro (Brazil) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Dominik Livakovic to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
121' Goal! Luka Modric (Croatia) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alisson into the bottom left corner.
121' Casemiro (Brazil) steps up and confidently directs the penalty into the left side of the goal!
121' Lovro Majer (Croatia) sends Alisson the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
121' Dominik Livakovic dives to the left side of the goal and brilliantly saves the penalty taken by Rodrygo (Brazil)!
121' Goal! Nikola Vlasic (Croatia) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alisson into the roof of the net.
121' The drama is set for its conclusion. Michael Oliver blows his whistle and the penalty shoot-out lottery begins!
120+3' Extra-time has not determined the winner of this match, so the drama of a penalty shootout will now take place.

120+2' Casemiro (Brazil) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the left side of the goal, but Dominik Livakovic makes a nice save.
120+1' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. Brazil have a free kick.
120' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
120' Lovro Majer (Croatia) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the left post.
119' Dangerous play by Casemiro (Brazil). Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
117' The whistle blows and Bruno Petkovic (Croatia) is booked for an infringement.
117' 1 - 1 Goal! Mislav Orsic passes the ball to Bruno Petkovic (Croatia) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Alisson couldn't do anything about it. 1:1.
115' Neymar (Brazil) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
115' Bruno Petkovic (Croatia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Oliver has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Brazil get a free kick.
115' Antony (Brazil) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
114' Antony (Brazil) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Good work from Brazil as they win a corner.
114' Zlatko Dalic decides to make a substitution. Marcelo Brozovic will be replaced by Mislav Orsic (Croatia).
112' Pedro (Brazil) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
110' Luka Modric (Croatia) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
110' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ante Budimir (Croatia) replaces Borna Sosa.
109' Luka Modric (Croatia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Now Croatia have a corner.
109' Neymar (Brazil) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
107' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
106' Here is a change after the half-time break. Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) is replaced by Fred.
106' Half-time substitution. Eder Militao (Brazil) is replaced by Alex Sandro.
106' Zlatko Dalic makes a switch. Lovro Majer is coming on in place of Mateo Kovacic (Croatia) at the start of the second period.
105+4' The first period of extra-time has ended, but the drama in this match is not yet finished.
105+1' 0 - 1 Neymar (Brazil) runs on to a clever pass from Lucas Paqueta and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.
105' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
105' Rodrygo lays the ball off to Danilo (Brazil), who hurriedly shoots from long range and sends the ball high over the bar into row Z.
104' The game is interrupted as Neymar (Brazil) is flagged offside.
103' Bruno Petkovic finds Marcelo Brozovic (Croatia) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
102' Mateo Kovacic (Croatia) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
101' Dominik Livakovic blocks Pedro (Brazil)'s effort from the edge of the box.
99' Rodrygo (Brazil) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Lucas Paqueta, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
97' Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) and Neymar try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
95' Danilo (Brazil) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
94' Borna Sosa (Croatia) makes a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
92' The corner from Neymar (Brazil) is cleared away by the defence.
91' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Antony (Brazil), but the defence gets it clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Brazil will take a corner.
91' Referee Michael Oliver has started the first period of extra time.
90+5' The referee blows his whistle to signal the end of the second half, with no clear winner in the 90 minutes.
90+3' Michael Oliver blows for a foul after Luka Modric (Croatia) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90+1' Rodrygo (Brazil) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
90+1' Rodrygo (Brazil) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Brazil will take a corner kick.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Neymar (Brazil) chips a pass over the line of defenders to get the ball to Pedro, but his attempt is intercepted and cleared.
89' A cross into the box from Borna Sosa (Croatia) is cleared.
87' The total number of attempts is 6:13. Shots on target – 0:7.
86' Antony (Brazil) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

86' Eder Militao (Brazil) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brazil.
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Richarlison as he is replaced by Pedro (Brazil).

82' Dominik Livakovic doesn't have to worry about that one. Casemiro puts a cross in towards Richarlison (Brazil), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball high over the crossbar.
82' Antony (Brazil) tries to find Lucas Paqueta, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
80' Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going inside the left post, but Dominik Livakovic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
78' Richarlison (Brazil) commits a foul and Michael Oliver immediately signals a free kick.
77' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Marquinhos (Brazil) for a tough tackle.
77' Neymar (Brazil) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

76' Neymar (Brazil) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Dominik Livakovic anticipates well and smothers the ball. Brazil have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
72' Zlatko Dalic prepares a substitution. Mario Pasalic is replaced by Nikola Vlasic (Croatia).
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Bruno Petkovic (Croatia) for Andrej Kramaric.
71' The attendance is 43893.
70' Michael Oliver blows his whistle. Antony (Brazil) commits a foul after dangerous play.
68' Casemiro (Brazil) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
66' A dangerous looking corner kick from Neymar (Brazil) is cleared to safety by the defence.

66' A tremendous drive by Lucas Paqueta (Brazil) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Dominik Livakovic makes a brilliant save. Corner kick. Brazil will have an opportunity.
66' Casemiro (Brazil) decides to have a go at goal from the long-range free kick, but the wall jumps as one and makes the block. Danger averted!
65' Marcelo Brozovic (Croatia) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Brazil are awarded a free kick.
64' Tite has decided to make a change. Rodrygo (Brazil) replaces Vinicius Junior.
61' The ball is cleared after Luka Modric (Croatia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
58' Andrej Kramaric (Croatia) and Marcelo Brozovic attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
56' Substitution. Antony (Brazil) on for Raphinha.

55' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Neymar (Brazil) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Dominik Livakovic pulls off an easy save.
53' Mario Pasalic (Croatia) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
51' Andrej Kramaric (Croatia) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
51' Corner kick. Luka Modric (Croatia) is ready to send the ball into the box.

50' Josip Juranovic (Croatia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Croatia will have a chance to score from a corner.
49' The Brazil players can’t believe it after referee Michael Oliver signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.

48' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Brazil.
48' The linesman raises his flag. Vinicius Junior (Brazil) is adjudged offside.
48' That looked a certain handball by Josip Juranovic (Croatia) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
47' Half-chance! Eder Militao (Brazil) plays a pass into the box, but Dominik Livakovic reacts well to snuff out the attack.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Andrej Kramaric (Croatia) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
42' Neymar (Brazil) fires a shot from the free kick straight at the middle of the net, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper’s hands.
41' Michael Oliver blows his whistle after Marcelo Brozovic (Croatia) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Free kick. Brazil will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
39' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 48:52.
36' Richarlison (Brazil) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
34' Croatia are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
31' A yellow card for a tackle by Marcelo Brozovic (Croatia). Michael Oliver doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
30' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
29' Neymar (Brazil) takes the free kick which is inaccurate and the defence has no problem with the clearance.

28' Josko Gvardiol (Croatia) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Michael Oliver with no other option than to blow for a foul. Brazil earn a free kick.
26' Luka Modric (Croatia) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area. The opposition's defence outnumbers the attacking players inside the box and they manage to make a clearance.
25' Tempers flare after Danilo (Brazil) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
24' The resulting corner from Raphinha (Brazil) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
23' Casemiro (Brazil) unleashes a first-time effort from long range, but it's blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play and Brazil have been awarded a corner kick.
20' A pass lands at the feet of Vinicius Junior (Brazil) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
19' Andrej Kramaric (Croatia) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
16' Casemiro (Brazil) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Croatia.
14' Luka Modric (Croatia) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

14' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Croatia.
13' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) latches onto a short pass from Josip Juranovic inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the left post.
11' Flag up against Richarlison (Brazil). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
10' Good defending. Vinicius Junior (Brazil) tries to find Raphinha inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
8' Mateo Kovacic (Croatia) makes a strong challenge and Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
7' Josip Juranovic (Croatia) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

5' That didn't go as planned! Vinicius Junior (Brazil) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the right side of the goal was too weak to get past Dominik Livakovic, who easily kept it out.
3' Casemiro (Brazil) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Croatia will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Michael Oliver.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
